fieldNotes.truckGate: Single controlled truck entrance off S Elwood International Port Rd at the NW corner. Satellite z21 shows a barrier/gate arm across the inbound lane plus a check-in pad; Street View (May 2025) shows the wide entrance throat with a yard hostler staged at the booth island.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Small dark-roofed guard booth in the center of the entrance drive, ~1-2 stall footprint, set on a concrete check-in island with the gate arm beside it (satellite z21 @ 41.39173,-88.14476).
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False because a staffed guard shack is present at the gate.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Cross-dock building: dock doors with trailers backed in on BOTH the long north wall and the long south wall (two opposing dock banks), confirmed in north-wall and south-wall z19 crops.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very wide gate apron and large internal yard with room to add a dedicated bypass/express lane around the single booth island.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Deep approach from road to docks (~50m+ throat plus expansive interior yard) easily holds a 3+ truck queue.
fieldNotes.preGateStaging: Paved shoulder/apron outside the gate along the access road where trailers stage (a Schneider trailer was parked there in Street View).
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large paved interior yard between the gate and the dock faces serves as a holding/queue area.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Continuous dock doors along both ~450m long walls; total well into 50+ band (est. ~120).
fieldNotes.dropArea: Hundreds of unhitched trailers parked in marked rows across north and south drop yards; 50+ band (est. capacity ~450).
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the NFI parcel. The adjacent CenterPoint Intermodal container yard across S Elwood International Port Rd is rail-served, but the DC building itself is truck/drayage fed.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town industrial setting at the CenterPoint Intermodal park near Elwood/Joliet IL, surrounded by farmland, woods and wetland; classified Rural per the small-town-industrial tie-break.
fieldNotes.connectivityIssue: Within a major intermodal logistics park (heavy infrastructure) so coverage is likely adequate; marked uncertain but set false.
fieldNotes.multiStep: No clearly visible second checkpoint (scale house or second booth) after the gate; set false.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale/weigh pad visible in the truck path.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~27.6 acres derived from the traced perimeter polygon (NW-SE oriented, ~443m diagonal).
fieldNotes.streetViewMeta: Only public-road panos exist (S Elwood International Port Rd, May 2025); the same entrance pano (41.39176,-88.14527) is the best ground view for the gate, perimeter entrance and pre-gate staging.
